instruction: Open vlc and load the video file from the desktop - the Never Gonna Give You Up music video.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.explanation: Two-step phrasing: open VLC, then load the video. Evaluator confirms the video is actively playing in VLC.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: VLC is playing AND the correct video file is loaded
Metric function 'is_vlc_playing' correctly handles 'expected.type=rule' parameter - receives rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter, not nested structure
Semantic verification logic is sound: checks VLC state=='playing' then verifies file name matches expected
Multiple fallback paths for extracting file info from VLC XML status (filename, title, uri, location, name) makes verification robust
Expected value 'Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4' matches the file downloaded in config
Getter 'get_vlc_playing_info' can access VLC HTTP interface which is enabled in launch config
Edge cases handled: HTTP request failures logged and return None, missing file info in XML logged and returns 0
Complete coverage of instruction requirements with no semantic or logical issues
